acceptance_criteria.criterion: Right-clicking a category tab header shows a context menu with "Edit Category" and "Delete Category" items.
"Edit Category" invokes TaggerViewModel.EditCategoryCommand with the clicked TaggerCategoryViewModel as parameter.
"Delete Category" invokes TaggerViewModel.DeleteCategoryCommand with the clicked TaggerCategoryViewModel as parameter.
AXAML compiles with zero errors and zero warnings.
App launches and renders the Tagger without visual regressions.
